FirstPeriodIrregular.1:
Imihango yanjye ya mbere
ntisanzwe: ese ni ibisanzwe?
FirstPeriodIrregular.6: Yego, ni ibisanzwe rwose. Dore impamvu uruhererekane rw'imihango rufata igihe kugira ngo rutuze, n'igihe bikwiye kubiganiraho.
FirstPeriodIrregular.8: Impamvu uruhererekane rutaba rusanzwe mu ntangiriro
FirstPeriodIrregular.11: Imisemburo igenga uruhererekane rw'imihango ifata igihe kugira ngo igere ku buringanire. Kubera iyo mpamvu, birasanzwe ko uruhererekane rwaba rugufi, rurerure, cyangwa rudakurikiranye neza mu myaka ya mbere.
FirstPeriodIrregular.12: Uruhererekane rushobora gufata umwaka umwe cyangwa ibiri, rimwe na rimwe birenzeho, kugira ngo rukurikirane neza. Iki gihe cyo kumenyera gitandukana cyane hagati y'umuntu n'undi, kandi si ikibazo.
FirstPeriodIrregular.14: Uruhererekane rutari rusanzwe mu ntangiriro ntirufatwa na rimwe nk'ubukererwe: umubiri wawe uba urimo gufata igihe ukeneye gusa.
FirstPeriodIrregular.15: Mu bihe byinshi cyane, nta cyo guhangayikira. Icyakora, ni byiza kujya kureba muganga niba imihango yawe imaze amezi menshi idaza nyuma yo kuza bwa mbere, cyangwa niba ugifite impungenge zidashira.
FirstPeriodIrregular.17: Imihango itaza mu mezi menshi, ububabare bukabije cyane, cyangwa kuva amaraso menshi cyane.
FirstPeriodIrregular.19: Uruhererekane rusanzwe cyangwa rudasanzwe: ni irihe tandukaniro?
FirstPeriodIrregular.21: Imihango yawe ya mbere: icyo witegura
FirstPeriodIrregular.23: Ibibazo bikunze kubazwa ku mihango yawe ya mbere
FirstPeriodIrregular.25: Imihango yanjye ya mbere ntisanzwe: ese ni ibisanzwe? — AWA

FirstPeriodProtection.1:
Ni ikihe kintu cyo kwirinda nahitamo
ku mihango yanjye ya mbere?
FirstPeriodProtection.6: Hari uburyo bwinshi bwo kwirinda mu gihe cy'imihango. Nta bwiza kurusha ubundi — ibyo wumva uguhesheje amahoro ni byo bigufasha guhitamo.
FirstPeriodProtection.11: Ku mihango ya mbere, agatambaro gakoreshwa ku mubiri (pad) ni ko koroshye gukoresha, kuko gashyirwa mu cyenda. Ikariso yagenewe imihango na tampon ni ubundi buryo ushobora kugerageza nyuma, igihe wumvise ubishaka.
FirstPeriodProtection.13: Biroroshye gukoresha, bishyirwa mu cyenda kandi bigahindurwa buri gihe.
FirstPeriodProtection.15: Ikariso ikurura amaraso, ishobora gukaywa, kandi yoroheje gukoresha buri munsi.
FirstPeriodProtection.17: Zishyirwa mu mubiri imbere; niba uzikoresha n'igihe uzikoresha, ni wowe ubihitamo, ku muvuduko wawe.
FirstPeriodProtection.18: Nta kintu cyo kwirinda kiba cyiza cyangwa kibi: buri kimwe gikwiranye n'imibiri itandukanye, imigenzo itandukanye, n'ibyo buri wese yumva amerewe neza. Tampon, urugero, zishyirwa mu mubiri imbere kandi zisaba kumenya umubiri wawe gato — nta kivuga ko ugomba kuzikoresha guhera ku mihango yawe ya mbere.
FirstPeriodProtection.20: Kugerageza ubwoko butandukanye bwo kwirinda uko iminsi igenda bigufasha kubona icyo ukwiriye cyane, nta gahato.
FirstPeriodProtection.21: Ugereranyije, ikikurinda gikwiye guhindurwa buri masaha 4 kugeza kuri 6, kenshi ku minsi y'amaraso menshi. Kugihindura buri gihe bigufasha kumererwa neza no kwita ku isuku y'ibice by'ibanga.
FirstPeriodProtection.25: Wakwita ute ku mihango ya mbere umunsi ku munsi?
FirstPeriodProtection.27: Imihango yawe ya mbere: icyo witegura
FirstPeriodProtection.29: Ni ikihe kintu cyo kwirinda nahitamo ku mihango yanjye ya mbere? — AWA

FirstPeriodSigns.1:
Ibimenyetso bya mbere
by'imihango yawe ya mbere
FirstPeriodSigns.6: Umubiri wawe akenshi ukwereka ibimenyetso mbere y'uko imihango yawe ya mbere ije. Kubimenya bishobora kugufasha gutungurwa bike.
FirstPeriodSigns.11: Mu mezi abanziriza imihango yawe ya mbere, umubiri wawe uhinduka buhoro buhoro: imiterere yawe irahinduka, ubwoya butangira kumera ahantu hashya, kandi n'uko ubira ibyuya birahinduka. Izi ni ingaruka zisanzwe z'ubwangavu, zitegura umubiri wawe buhoro buhoro.
FirstPeriodSigns.13: Izi mpinduka ntizibaho zose icyarimwe, cyangwa ku muvuduko umwe, kuri buri wese — ni ibisanzwe rwose.
FirstPeriodSigns.15: Umubiri wawe uhinduka buhoro buhoro: imiterere yawe, ubwoya, n'uko ubira ibyuya bishobora guhinduka.
FirstPeriodSigns.17: Amatembabuzi make y'umweru akenshi agaragara amezi make mbere y'imihango yawe ya mbere.
FirstPeriodSigns.19: Ushobora kumva umuhangayiko woroheje cyangwa gutigita mu nda yo hasi.
FirstPeriodSigns.21: Birasanzwe kumva wunvikana cyangwa urakara kurusha uko bisanzwe.
FirstPeriodSigns.23: Ushobora kubona kuribwa guke cyangwa kubyimba.
FirstPeriodSigns.24: Ibi bimenyetso bikunze kuvuga ko imihango yawe ya mbere izaza mu mezi akurikira, nubwo bidashoboka guhanura itariki nyayo. Kugira ikikurinda hafi bihinduka akamenyero keza muri iki gihe.
FirstPeriodSigns.26: Ibi bimenyetso ni ibyerekana muri rusange, ntabwo ari ihanura rinoze. Buri mubiri ugira umuvuduko wawo.
FirstPeriodSigns.28: Imihango yawe ya mbere: icyo witegura
FirstPeriodSigns.30: Nabwirwa n'iki ko imihango yanjye ya mbere iri hafi kuza?
FirstPeriodSigns.34: Ibimenyetso bya mbere mbere y'imihango yawe ya mbere — AWA

FlowColorsTextures.6: Ibara n'imiterere y'amaraso y'imihango yawe bivuga byinshi ku buzima bw'imisemburo yawe. Menya kubisoma kugira ngo usobanukirwe uruhererekane rwawe neza.
FlowColorsTextures.14: Amaraso mashya. Asanzwe mu ntangiriro y'imihango yawe.
FlowColorsTextures.16: Amaraso ashaje, asanzwe hagati mu ruhererekane.
FlowColorsTextures.18: Amaraso yahinduwe n'umwuka, akenshi mu mpera z'imihango yawe.
FlowColorsTextures.20: Gishobora kugaragaza amaraso make cyangwa impinduka y'imisemburo.
FlowColorsTextures.22: Gishobora guhuzwa n'indwara yandura cyangwa kudahagarara neza kw'umubiri.
FlowColorsTextures.34: Uruhererekane rusanzwe. Umubiri wawe urimo gusohora igice cy'imbere cy'inda ibyara.
FlowColorsTextures.38: Gishobora kugaragara mu ntangiriro/mu mpera y'imihango yawe cyangwa igihe imisemburo itaringaniye.
FlowColorsTextures.40: Kirebereho hafi niba kiherekejwe n'umunuko ukomeye, kwishima, cyangwa ububabare.
FlowColorsTextures.42: Kuva amaraso menshi cyane (guhindura ikikurinda buri saha 1–2)
FlowColorsTextures.49: Bijyanye n'amaraso yawe n'ibyo wumva umereye neza.
FlowColorsTextures.54: Amaraso y'imihango: gusobanukirwa amabara n'imiterere — AWA

FlowMenstrual.1:
Kwita ku isuku y'ibice by'ibanga
mu gihe cy'imihango
FlowMenstrual.6: Kwita ku isuku y'ibice by'ibanga ni ukubaha umubiri wawe n'uburinganire bwawo karemano.
FlowMenstrual.13: Mu gihe cy'imihango, umubiri wawe uruhinduka kandi ukarushaho kwiyumva. Kugira imigenzo myiza bifasha kwirinda kurakara kw'uruhu n'indwara zandura, kandi bigufasha kumererwa neza buri munsi.
FlowMenstrual.14: Oga buhoro: kwiyoza gusa amazi meza, uvuye imbere ujya inyuma, birahagije kurinda ibinyabuzima karemano byawe.
FlowMenstrual.15: Hindura ikikurinda buri gihe: buri masaha 4 kugeza kuri 6 kugira ngo wirinde ubuhehere n'impumuro mbi.
FlowMenstrual.16: Hitamo ipamba: ikariso y'ipamba ituma uruhu ruhumeka kandi igabanya ibyago byo kurakara.
FlowMenstrual.18: Gukaraba imbere mu gitsina n'amazi atemba, bibangamira ibinyabuzima karemano byawe
FlowMenstrual.19: Kumara igihe kirekire wambaye pad cyangwa tampon itose
FlowMenstrual.21: Impumuro cyangwa amatembabuzi bidasanzwe, atandukanye n'ibisanzwe kuri wowe
FlowMenstrual.22: Ububabare bukomeye cyangwa ibimenyetso bigutera impungenge
FlowMenstrual.24: Umubiri wawe usanzwe ufite uburyo karemano bwo kuringaniza. Kwiyoza buhoro akenshi birahagije.
FlowMenstrual.35: Uko wavura ububabare bwo mu nda bw'imihango mu buryo karemano
FlowMenstrual.38: Kwita ku isuku y'ibice by'ibanga mu gihe cy'imihango · AWA

HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.6: Ikinini, agapfunyika ko ku ruhu (patch), impeta yo mu gitsina, urushinge ruguma mu kuboko (implant), IUD y'imisemburo: icyo bitandukaniyeho n'uko wategura uburyo bukwiranye n'ubuzima bwawe bwa buri munsi.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.12: Uburyo bw'imisemburo bukoresha imisemburo kugira ngo bwirinde gusama. Bitewe n'uburyo, bushobora cyane cyane kubuza ovulation, gutuma amatembabuzi yo mu nkanka y'inda aba menshi, no guhindura imiterere yo mu nda ibyara.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.13: Uburyo bw'imisemburo bukumira gusama bukora bute?
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.16: Bumwe mu buryo bubuza cyangwa buhagarika irekurwa ry'igi.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.18: Amatembabuzi ashobora kuba menshi, bigatuma intanga zigorwa no kunyuramo.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.20: Guhurira hamwe kw'ubu buryo bifasha kugabanya ibyago byo gusama.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.21: Si uburyo bwose busaba urwego rumwe rwo kubukurikirana. Itandukaniro nyamukuru ni inshuro ukeneye gutekereza ku gukumira gusama.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.23: Kuva ku gikorwa cya buri munsi kugeza ku burinzi bw'igihe kirekire
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.30: Cyiza niba ushaka kwiyobora mu gukumira gusama
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.34: Cyoroshye niba ukunda kwirinda gahunda ya buri munsi
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.38: Uburyo butagaragara bufite ibikorwa bike bya buri munsi
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.42: Gikwiranye niba ushaka kwirinda gusama igihe kirekire
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.46: Igisubizo cy'igihe kirekire gisaba kwitabwaho gake cyane
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.48: Uko uburyo busaba ibikorwa bike bya buri munsi, ni ko ukenera kubitekerezaho gake. Ibi bishobora kugufasha niba uzi ko ushobora kwibagirwa ikinini cyangwa guhindura.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.49: Nta buryo bwiza bumwe kuri bose. Guhitamo neza bishingira ku buzima bwawe bwa buri munsi, ibyo ukunda, uko umubiri wawe ubyakira, n'imigambi yawe.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.51: Bumwe mu buryo busaba igikorwa cya buri munsi, mu gihe ubundi bukora ibyumweru byinshi cyangwa imyaka.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.53: Uko uburyo bumwe bwumvikana bishobora gutandukana hagati y'umuntu n'undi. Kuganira n'umuganga bishobora kugufasha kumenya icyagukwiriye.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.55: Niba wiringiye gutwita vuba cyangwa nyuma, igihe uburyo bumara no kuba bwakurwaho bishobora kugufasha guhitamo.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.57: Ibanga, koroshya, kutagira gahunda ya buri munsi, cyangwa uburinzi bumara igihe kirekire: ibyo ushyize imbere bifite akamaro muri iki cyemezo.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.59: “Nakwishimira gutekereza ku gukumira gusama buri munsi, buri cyumweru, cyangwa gake gusa mu mwaka?”
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.61: Ikinini cyangwa uburyo busaba kwitabwaho buri gihe
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.63: Patch cyangwa impeta, bijyanye n'umuvuduko uhisemo
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.65: Implant cyangwa IUD y'imisemburo y'igihe kirekire
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.67: Guhitamo uburyo bw'imisemburo bwo gukumira gusama bigomba kwita ku miterere yawe bwite n'iy'ubuvuzi. Umuganga ashobora kugufasha kugereranya inyungu, ingaruka, ibituma budakwiye, n'ingaruka zishoboka.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.70: Uburyo bw'imisemburo bukoresha imvange zitandukanye z'imisemburo n'ingengabihe zitandukanye zo kubukoresha.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.71: Ikinini, patch, n'impeta bisaba kubikurikirana buri gihe, mu gihe implant na IUD y'imisemburo ari uburyo bw'igihe kirekire.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.72: Guhitamo bigomba guhuza n'ubuzima bwawe bwa buri munsi, ibyo ukunda, uko umubiri wawe ubyakira, n'imigambi yawe.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.73: Nta buryo bwiza kuri bose — ikiruta ni uko bukwiranye n'ibyo ukeneye n'imiterere yawe.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.75: Gufata igihe cyo kugereranya uburyo n'umuganga bigufasha guhitamo uburyo bwo gukumira gusama ushobora gukoresha utuje kandi uko bikwiye.
HormonalTreatmentsPanorama.76: Incamake y'imiti y'imisemburo ikumira gusama — AWA

HotFlashes.6: Impamvu bibaho, uko wamenya ibibitera, n'ibisubizo bishobora gufasha igihe bibaye ikibazo.
HotFlashes.14: Umushyiko ukomeye (hot flashes) ni usanzwe cyane mu gihe cyo kwimukira muri menopause. Uterwa igice n'impinduka z'imisemburo zigira ingaruka ku buryo ubwonko bugenga ubushyuhe bw'umubiri.
HotFlashes.15: Impinduka nto mu bushyuhe bw'umubiri zishobora kumvikana nk'ubushyuhe bukabije bwihuse. Umubiri usubiza mu kwagura imitsi y'amaraso yo ku ruhu, bishobora gutera kumva ubushyuhe, guhinduka umutuku, na rimwe na rimwe ibyuya byinshi.
HotFlashes.17: Abagore bamwe bagira inshuro nke mu cyumweru, mu gihe abandi bashobora kugira nyinshi ku munsi. Ubukana n'igihe bimara na byo bishobora gutandukana.
HotFlashes.18: Iyo bibaye ukiryamye, umushyiko ushobora gutera ibyuya by'ijoro. Bishobora gutuma ukangukira kenshi kandi ntiruhuke neza.
HotFlashes.19: Kubura ibitotsi bishobora kongera umunaniro, ingorane zo kwita ku kintu, no kurakara ku manywa. Bityo birashobora gufasha gushyira ubwiza bw'ibitotsi mu isuzuma ry'uko ibimenyetso byawe bikugiraho ingaruka.
HotFlashes.21: Pajama zihumeka, ibyo kuryamaho byoroshye, n'icyumba gikonje bihagije bishobora gufasha kugabanya ubwo buribwe nijoro.
HotFlashes.22: Ibintu bimwe bishobora gutera cyangwa kongera umushyiko. Ntibitera ibimenyetso kuri buri wese, ariko kubimenya bishobora kugufasha gusobanukirwa neza uko wowe bikugendekera.
HotFlashes.26: Icyumba gishyushye cyane cyangwa imyenda iremereye cyane
HotFlashes.28: Mu byumweru bike, andika igihe umushyiko wawe ubaho, ubukana bwawo, n'ibyabaye mbere gato. Ibi bishobora kugufasha kubona ibigutera wowe.
HotFlashes.30: Gumisha aho uri hakonje kandi hinjira umwuka
HotFlashes.31: Humeka buhoro mu gihe umushyiko ubaye
HotFlashes.33: Ibi bikorwa ntibizatuma umushyiko urangira ahubwo, ariko bishobora koroshya kuwugenzura no kugabanya uburibwe iyo ubaye.
HotFlashes.34: Umushyiko ni usanzwe mu gihe cya perimenopause na menopause. Nyamara, ntugomba kubyihanganira gusa niba bikugoye kubaho. Muganga cyangwa umubyaza ashobora gusuzuma ibimenyetso byawe no kuganira nawe ku nzira zinyuranye.
HotFlashes.35: Ni ryari wakwiriye gufata gahunda yo kubonana?
HotFlashes.36: Kujya kureba muganga bishobora gufasha cyane iyo ibimenyetso bigira ingaruka zikomeye ku buzima bwawe bwa buri munsi cyangwa iyo ushaka kumenya ibisubizo bihari.
HotFlashes.38: Umushyiko cyangwa ibyuya by'ijoro bibaho kenshi bigatuma ukangukira kenshi, umunaniro ukomeye, cyangwa ingorane zo gukora mu buryo busanzwe ku manywa.
HotFlashes.39: Iyo ubuzima bwa buri munsi bugoye
HotFlashes.40: Niba umushyiko ubangamira akazi kawe, ibikorwa byawe, ingendo, imibanire n'abandi, cyangwa amahoro yawe ya buri munsi gusa.
HotFlashes.42: Izamuka rigaragara ry'inshuro cyangwa ubukana bw'ibimenyetso rikwiye kuganirwaho kugira ngo habonwe ibisubizo bikwiranye cyane.
HotFlashes.44: Hashobora gutangwa uburyo bukoresha imisemburo n'ubudakoresha imisemburo bijyanye n'imiterere yawe. Umuhanga ashobora kugufasha gupima inyungu zabyo, ingaruka, n'ibituma bidakwiye.
HotFlashes.46: Umushyiko ushobora kugira impamvu zitandukanye. Ibimenyetso bimwe bishobora no guhuzwa n'umuti, indi ndwara, cyangwa impinduka ikomeye mu buzima bwawe. Niba hari icyo wumva kidasanzwe, gishya, cyangwa gikomeye cyane, ni byiza kuganira n'umuhanga aho kwemeza ko ari menopause.
HotFlashes.48: Ububabare mu gituza, guhumeka bigoranye gutunguranye, kumva ugiye gucika intege, intege nke zitunguranye, cyangwa kubyimba kudasanzwe kubabaza mu kuguru kumwe bisaba ubuvuzi bwihuse.
HotFlashes.49: Ni ibihe bimenyetso bikwiye kwitabwaho by'umwihariko?
HotFlashes.50: Ububabare mu gituza budasanzwe cyangwa bukabije
HotFlashes.51: Guhumeka bigoranye gutunguranye cyangwa ingorane ikomeye yo guhumeka
HotFlashes.52: Kumva ugiye gucika intege cyangwa guta ubwenge
HotFlashes.53: Intege nke zitunguranye, cyangwa ingorane zo kuvuga cyangwa kubona
HotFlashes.54: Kubyimba kubabaza, kudasanzwe, mu kuguru kumwe
HotFlashes.56: Niba umushyiko ukubangamiye ku buryo ukeneye kuwugenzura, inzira nyinshi zishobora gutekerezwaho. Bitewe n'imiterere yawe, umuhanga ashobora kuganira ku bikorwa by'imibereho, imiti idakoresha imisemburo, cyangwa, igihe bikwiye, ubuvuzi bw'imisemburo.
HotFlashes.58: Imyaka, ibimenyetso, amateka y'ubuvuzi, imiti ufata ubu, n'ibyo wishimira bishobora byose guhindura uburyo butangwa.
HotFlashes.60: Kugerayo ufite amakuru make bishobora gutuma kujya kureba muganga birushaho kugira akamaro. Ushobora gukurikirana, mu minsi cyangwa ibyumweru bike, inshuro ibyo bimenyetso bibaho, ubukana bwabyo, n'ingaruka bigira ku bitotsi byawe cyangwa ibikorwa byawe.
HotFlashes.64: Ukunze kubigira ku manywa, nijoro, cyangwa byombi?
HotFlashes.65: Bibangamira ibitotsi byawe cyangwa ibikorwa byawe?
HotFlashes.67: Ese ufata umuti uwo ari wo wose cyangwa uburyo bw'imisemburo bwo gukumira gusama muri iki gihe?
HotFlashes.68: Ntugomba gutegereza ko ibimenyetso biba bikabije cyane mbere yo kubiganiraho. Kujya kureba muganga bishobora no gufasha gusa kumva ibiri kuba no kumenya ibisubizo bihari.
HotFlashes.70: Umushyiko ni usanzwe mu gihe cyo kwimukira muri menopause.
HotFlashes.71: Kumenya ibikubaho bishobora kugufasha kugenzura neza ibyo bihe.
HotFlashes.72: Imigenzo yoroshye ishobora kugabanya uburibwe bwa buri munsi.
HotFlashes.73: Niba ibimenyetso bibangamira ibitotsi byawe cyangwa ubuzima bwa buri munsi, ganira n'umuhanga.
HotFlashes.74: Uburyo bunyuranye bwo kubigenzura bushobora kuganirwaho bijyanye n'imiterere yawe.
HotFlashes.75: Umushyiko ni usanzwe, ariko ntiwagombye gusuzugurwa iyo ugira ingaruka ku bitotsi byawe, akazi, cyangwa amahoro yawe. Kwita ku bimenyetso byawe no kuganira n'umuhanga bishobora kugufasha gusobanukirwa neza impamvu yabyo no gushaka ibisubizo bikwiye.
HotFlashes.76: Iyi nkuru ni iy'amakuru gusa kandi ntisimbura inama z'ubuvuzi zihariye.

HydrationCycle.1:
Kuguma ufite amazi ahagije
mu ruhererekane rwawe
HydrationCycle.6: Bishobora gusa n'ibitangaje ariko ni ukuri: kuguma ufite amazi ahagije bifasha umubiri wawe kubika amazi make mu ruhererekane rwawe rwose.
HydrationCycle.15: Bishobora gusa n'ibitangaje ariko ni ukuri: kuguma ufite amazi ahagije bifasha umubiri kubika amazi make no kugabanya kubyimba mu nda, cyane cyane ugana mu mpera y'uruhererekane.
HydrationCycle.17: Iyo umubiri ukeneye amazi, ukunze kuyabika cyane nk'ingamba. Kunywa bihagije bibwira umubiri, ahubwo, ko ushobora kuyarekura byoroshye.
HydrationCycle.18: Ibikenerwa by'amazi bikomeza kuba bisa muri rusange, hamwe n'utuntu duto bitewe n'icyiciro:
HydrationCycle.20: Amazi make arenzeho afasha kuziba icyuho cy'amazi yatakaye no kugabanya kubyimba.
HydrationCycle.22: Ibikenewe bikomeza kuba bimwe; izamuka rito ry'ubushyuhe bw'umubiri rishobora kongera inyota.
HydrationCycle.24: Kunywa amazi ahagije bifasha kugabanya kumva ubyimbye akenshi bigaragara muri iki gihe.
HydrationCycle.25: Intego ni litiro 1,5 kugeza kuri 2 ku munsi, birenzeho gato mu gihe cy'imihango yawe kugira ngo uzibe icyuho cy'amazi yatakaye.
HydrationCycle.27: Litiro 1,5 kugeza kuri 2 ku munsi, birenzeho gato mu gihe cy'imihango yawe.
HydrationCycle.29: Tangawizi cyangwa chamomile bitanga amazi aroroheje mu gihe cy'ububabare bwo mu nda.
HydrationCycle.31: Kugabanya ibinyobwa birimo isukari nyinshi cyangwa kafeyine bishobora gufasha ugana mu mpera y'uruhererekane.
HydrationCycle.37: Imigenzo mike yoroshye akenshi irahagije kugira ngo ugume ufite amazi ahagije utabitekerejeho:
HydrationCycle.38: Ugire icupa ry'amazi hafi yawe umunsi wose
HydrationCycle.39: Huza ikirahuri cy'amazi n'akamenyero usanzwe ufite (kubyuka, buri funguro)
HydrationCycle.40: Vanga icyayi cy'ibimera niba amazi asanzwe atakuryohera
HydrationCycle.41: Mu gihe ukora imyitozo ngororamubiri, ibuka kunywa mbere, mu gihe, na nyuma yayo kugira ngo uzibe icyuho cy'ibyuya byatakaye.
HydrationCycle.45: Kunywa amazi ahagije bifasha umubiri kubika amazi make.
HydrationCycle.47: Icyayi cya tangawizi cyangwa chamomile na cyo gitanga amazi aroroheje mu gihe cy'ububabare bwo mu nda.
HydrationCycle.48: Kuguma ufite amazi ahagije bifasha umubiri kubika amazi make no kugabanya kubyimba mu nda.
HydrationCycle.49: Intego ni litiro 1,5 kugeza kuri 2 ku munsi, birenzeho gato mu gihe cy'imihango yawe.
HydrationCycle.50: Icyayi cya tangawizi cyangwa chamomile na cyo gishobora gutuza mu gihe cy'ububabare bwo mu nda.
HydrationCycle.51: Inyota ikabije, idahita, ikwiye kubwirwa umuganga.
HydrationCycle.52: Ibikubiyemo by'amakuru. Iyi nkuru ntisimbura inama z'ubuvuzi zihariye. Niba ufite impungenge, shaka inama z'umuganga.
HydrationCycle.53: Kuguma ufite amazi ahagije mu ruhererekane rwawe — AWA

Istihada.6: Gutandukanya amaraso adasanzwe n'imihango yawe isanzwe, hamwe n'ibimenyetso rusange bigufasha kuyobora.
Istihada.8: Ibi bikubiyemo ni iby'inyigisho gusa. Ibibazo by'idini bigomba kwemezwa n'abahanga babifitiye ubushobozi. AWA ntitanga fatwa cyangwa imyanzuro y'idini yihariye.
Istihada.14: Isengesho na sawm mu gihe cya Istihâda
Istihada.15: Wakora iki mu gihe ufite gushidikanya?
Istihada.17: Istihâda ivuga kuva amaraso kubaho hanze y'uruhererekane rw'imihango rusanzwe, cyangwa akomeza arenze igihe cy'imihango cyemewe n'imigenzo y'Isilamu. Bitandukanye n'imihango (hayd) cyangwa nifas (kuva amaraso nyuma yo kubyara), nta mwanya umwe ifite mu mihango y'idini: muri rusange ifatwa nk'amaraso afite ubundi bwoko, rimwe na rimwe ahuzwa n'impamvu y'ubuvuzi.
Istihada.19: Ibi bikubiyemo bisobanura igitekerezo mu buryo rusange; ntibigufasha kumenya niba kuva amaraso kwihariye ari Istihâda mu miterere yawe bwite.
Istihada.20: Gutandukanya Istihâda n'imihango cyangwa uruhererekane rudasanzwe bishobora kugorana, kuko amaraso rimwe na rimwe ashobora kugaragara asa, agatandukana mu bukana, cyangwa agakomeza mu buryo budasanzwe. Iki kibazo kimenyekanwa n'abahanga ubwabo, ari yo mpamvu hari uburyo bwinshi bwo kuyimenya.
Istihada.22: Ni ibisanzwe kutamenya ako kanya icyo kuva amaraso kudasanzwe kuvuze; uku gushidikanya ni ibisanzwe, si ikosa ryawe.
Istihada.23: Ibintu bimwe bishobora gufasha kuyobora ibitekerezo byawe, bitari amategeko rusange, kuko ibimenyetso nyabyo bitandukana bitewe n'amashuri y'amategeko y'idini.
Istihada.29: Uko amaraso ahinduka uko igihe gihita
Istihada.33: Ibi bintu ni ibimenyetso rusange, si amategeko yuzuye: bishobora gusobanurwa mu buryo butandukanye n'abahanga n'amashuri y'amategeko y'idini.
Istihada.34: Gufata igihe cyo kureba amaraso yawe mu minsi myinshi, nta kwihuta, bigufasha gusobanukirwa neza imiterere yawe mbere yo gufata umwanzuro.
Istihada.36: Andika itariki yo gutangira kandi, niba bishoboka, uburebure busanzwe bw'uruhererekane rwawe
Istihada.37: Reba niba amaraso akurikiza uburyo bwegereye imihango yawe yabanje
Istihada.39: Andika ibi wabonye niba uteganya kujya kureba umuhanga mu idini cyangwa umuganga
Istihada.40: Mu gihe cya Istihâda, isengesho na sawm muri rusange biguma ari itegeko, bitandukanye n'igihe cy'imihango. Ingamba z'isuku (nk'ikikurinda gikwiye) zirasabwa kugira ngo ugume ukora ibyo kuramya, hakurikijwe uburyo bwigishwa n'amashuri anyuranye y'amategeko y'idini.
Istihada.42: Ingamba nyazo (nko gusubiramo wudu) zishobora gutandukana bitewe n'ishuri ry'amategeko y'idini ukurikiza; kwiyambaza igitekerezo usanzwe ukurikiza cyangwa umuhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi bigufasha kuzikoresha neza.
Istihada.43: Gushidikanya bihoraho ku miterere y'amaraso ni ibisanzwe, kandi ntibikwiye kuba isoko yo guhangayika birenze urugero.
Istihada.44: Reba igihe n'uburyo bisanzwe by'imihango yawe bwite
Istihada.45: Jya kureba umuganga niba amaraso adasanzwe cyangwa amaze igihe kirekire
Istihada.46: Baza umuhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi igitekerezo cye ku ruhande rw'idini
Istihada.47: Ibuka ko igisubizo rusange kidasimbura inama zikwiranye n'imiterere yawe
Istihada.49: Ibi bikubiyemo biguma ari iby'inyigisho kandi rusange: si fatwa cyangwa umwanzuro w'idini wihariye. Ku miterere yose yihariye, cyane cyane mu gihe cyo gushidikanya kumaze igihe, igitekerezo cy'umuhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi ni cyo gishingirwaho.
Istihada.51: Istihâda ni igitekerezo gitandukanya kuva amaraso kudasanzwe n'imihango cyangwa nifas, gifite ingaruka zihariye ku isengesho na sawm. Mu gihe cyo gushidikanya, kwitegereza neza n'igitekerezo cy'umuhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi bikomeza kuba inkunga nziza.

LhTests.15: LH (luteinizing hormone) ikorwa n'ubwonko kandi igenga imikorere y'intanga ngore. Ibipimo bya ovulation bimenya izamuka ry'iyi misemburo, ritera irekurwa ry'igi nyuma y'amasaha 24 kugeza kuri 36.
LhTests.16: Agace ko gupimisha inkari gapima urugero rwa LH: umurongo w'igipimo wijimye nk'umurongo w'igenzura cyangwa urenzeho werekana izamuka.
LhTests.17: Birasabwa gutangira gupima iminsi mike mbere y'itariki ya ovulation yagereranyijwe hashingiwe ku ruhererekane rwawe.
LhTests.19: Tangira iminsi mike mbere y'itariki ya ovulation yagereranyijwe hashingiwe ku burebure bw'impuzandengo bw'uruhererekane rwawe.
